title: automation: a cloned packaged flow reaches no Studio surface — the clone is stored with no package, and every Studio Automations rail lists only package-scoped flows
body:
QA-source: #21330 · automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract · acceptance[6]

## What fails

ADR-0126 §7.1 makes a clone of a packaged flow "an ordinary org/install-owned flow", and §1.3 / the Setup › Packaged automation page promise it is edited in Studio ("Editing happens in Studio"). On 17.6.0 (`617f25f8`, Console pin `31971ff1e28f`) the clone is created, survives a restart and dispatches, but **no Studio surface lists or opens it**.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert/clone {"name":"qa_urgent_alert_clone","label":"QA urgent alert clone"}` → 200, `status: draft`.
2. `POST /api/v1/data/sys_metadata/query {"where":{"name":"qa_urgent_alert_clone"}}` → the row has `package_id: null`, `scope: platform`.
3. `GET /api/v1/meta/flow?package=com.example.showcase` → 30 flows, clone absent. Bare `GET /api/v1/meta/flow` → 31 flows, clone present.
4. Console `/_console/studio` → "No writable packages yet"; the only installed entry is the read-only showcase package. `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations` lists the 30 packaged flows, not the clone. The deep link `…/automations?surface=flow%3Aqa_urgent_alert_clone` redirects to another flow.
5. Expected: the clone appears on a Studio Automations rail (or the clone lands somewhere Studio can open). Actual: unreachable from Studio.

Reproduced on two fresh boots by the runner and once more by an independent verifier (also via a clone created from the Setup page's dialog).

## Mechanism

- The clone arm strips `_packageId` / `_provenance` on purpose (`packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`) and persists a package-less row.
- Studio's Automations rail is package-scoped at the pin: objectui `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `loadPackageSurfaces(client, 'flow', packageId)` (both `client.list(type, {packageId})` and `listDrafts({packageId, type})`); Studio has only `/studio`, `/studio/:packageId`, `/studio/:packageId/:tab` (`apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`); the landing lists writable and installed packages only.
- So a package-less flow matches no rail.

## Notes

- The durability half of the checklist clause's expected fail is fixed (`cb4c31d`, #20907); this card is the reachability half only. It was recorded in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` §8 as row D18 ("safe to file") and never filed.
- The fix needs an owner decision — either Studio gains a surface for package-less (org/install-owned) flows (objectui), or the clone lands in a writable package (objectstack, against the deliberate provenance strip).
- Severity (verifier): major — the engine half works, but the one promised authoring surface cannot reach what it produces.

Full run evidence: #21330.
